status: Adult-use legalized August 2023; first cannabis business licenses issued June 2025 (retail opening wave 2025-2026). Regulator: Office of Cannabis Management (OCM). Hemp-derived (LPHE) retail predates licensed cannabis retail.

facts.label: Licensed cannabis businesses statewide
facts.source: Minnesota OCM, licensed businesses roster xlsx (mn.gov asset tcm1202-714418), sheet 'Licensed cannabis businesses'
facts.verify: 313 data rows. By type: Microbusiness 219, Medical Cannabis Combination 19, Mezzobusiness 17, Retail 14, Transporter 12, Wholesaler 8, Cultivator 7, Testing 6, Delivery 5, Event Organizer 4, Manufacturer 2. First license issued 2025-06-18, latest 2026-07-06. Saved as mn-ocm-licensed-live.xlsx; parse with zipfile+ElementTree.

facts.label: Licensed cannabis businesses in Minneapolis, the most of any Minnesota city
facts.source: Same OCM roster, City column = Minneapolis
facts.verify: 24 rows: 15 Microbusiness, 3 Mezzobusiness, 2 Event Organizer, 1 each Delivery, Transporter, Wholesaler, Medical Cannabis Combination. 19 of the 24 are retail sites with street addresses. City ranking: Minneapolis 24, Saint Paul 23, Moorhead 15, Duluth 6. Examples: Green Goods (207 S 9th St), Legacy Cannabis (2930 S Lyndale Ave), Watchtower Dispensary (3400 University Ave SE).

facts.label: Hemp-derived (LPHE) retailers with Minneapolis retail addresses
facts.source: Same OCM roster, sheet 'Licensed LPHE businesses'
facts.verify: 2,742 rows in the LPHE sheet, 2,611 LPHE Retailers statewide, 253 with 'Minneapolis, MN' retail site address. LPHE = lower-potency hemp edibles, a distinct registration from cannabis business licenses; never sum the two.

facts.label: Cannabis gross receipts tax rate
facts.source: Minnesota Department of Revenue, Cannabis Tax page (updated 2026-04-23)
facts.verify: 15% cannabis gross receipts tax plus 6.875% state sales tax plus local taxes. Original 2023 rate was 10% (per 2024 tax handbook and LGCA docs); raised to 15%.

facts.label: Cannabis gross receipts tax collections, FY2024
facts.source: Minnesota Department of Revenue, 2024 Tax Handbook (corrected edition posted June 2026), Revenue Collections table
facts.verify: FY2023 $0, FY2024 $11,628,000 at the original 10% rate. FY2024 pre-dates licensed dispensaries, so these collections are mostly hemp-derived (LPHE) sales. Frame as hemp-era collections, never as dispensary sales.

facts.label: 2025 Local Government Cannabis Aid distributed to cities
facts.source: Minnesota Department of Revenue, 2025 Local Government Cannabis Aid summary and city amounts (rev. 08/2025)
facts.verify: OCM certified zero licensed cannabis businesses as of 2025-01-01 (licensing began mid-2025) and the aid was repealed (2025 1st Spec. Sess. Ch. 13 art. 8); city distributions $0.00 statewide, $2.37M cities share cancelled to the General Fund. Account balance was $4,929,084.42 on 2025-06-30.
